054  private static int availableToCount(long available) {
055    // Top bit has to be set
056    if (available < 0) {
057      return 64;
058    }
059
060    int count = 0;
061
062    // Top bit not set, we will eventually get a 0 bit
063    while ((available & 0x1) != 0) {
064      count++;
065      available >>= 1;
066    }
067    return count;
068  }

137  private static String opModeToString(long id) {
138    if (id == 0) {
139      return "";
140    }
141    m_opModesMutex.lock();
142    try {
143      OpModeOption option = m_opModes.get(id);
144      if (option != null) {
145        return option.name;
146      }
147    } finally {
148      m_opModesMutex.unlock();
149    }
150    return "<" + id + ">";
151  }

153  private static class MatchDataSender {
154    private static final String SMART_DASHBOARD_TYPE = "DriverStation";
155
156    final StringPublisher gameData;
157    final StringPublisher eventName;
158    final IntegerPublisher matchNumber;
159    final IntegerPublisher replayNumber;
160    final IntegerPublisher matchType;
161    final BooleanPublisher alliance;
162    final IntegerPublisher station;
163    final IntegerPublisher allianceStation;
164    final StructPublisher<ControlWord> controlWord;
165    final StringPublisher opMode;
166    String oldEventName = "";
167    String oldGameData = "";
168    int oldMatchNumber;
169    int oldReplayNumber;
170    int oldMatchType;
171    boolean oldIsRedAlliance = true;
172    int oldStationNumber = 1;
173    int oldAllianceStation = 0;
174    final ControlWord oldControlWord = new ControlWord();
175    final ControlWord currentControlWord = new ControlWord();
176
177    MatchDataSender() {
178      var table = NetworkTableInstance.getDefault().getTable("DriverStation");
179      table
180          .getStringTopic(".type")
181          .publishEx(
182              StringTopic.TYPE_STRING, "{\"SmartDashboard\":\"" + SMART_DASHBOARD_TYPE + "\"}")
183          .set(SMART_DASHBOARD_TYPE);
184      gameData = table.getStringTopic("GameData").publish();
185      gameData.set("");
186      eventName = table.getStringTopic("EventName").publish();
187      eventName.set("");
188      matchNumber = table.getIntegerTopic("MatchNumber").publish();
189      matchNumber.set(0);
190      replayNumber = table.getIntegerTopic("ReplayNumber").publish();
191      replayNumber.set(0);
192      matchType = table.getIntegerTopic("MatchType").publish();
193      matchType.set(0);
194      alliance = table.getBooleanTopic("IsRedAlliance").publish();
195      alliance.set(true);
196      station = table.getIntegerTopic("StationNumber").publish();
197      station.set(1);
198      allianceStation = table.getIntegerTopic("AllianceStationID").publish();
199      allianceStation.set(0);
200      controlWord = table.getStructTopic("ControlWord", ControlWord.struct).publish();
201      controlWord.set(oldControlWord);
202      opMode = table.getStringTopic("OpMode").publish();
203      opMode.set("");
204    }
205
206    @SuppressWarnings("VariableDeclarationUsageDistance")
207    private void sendMatchData() {
208      AllianceStationID allianceID = DriverStationJNI.getAllianceStation();
209      final int stationNumber =
210          switch (allianceID) {
211            case BLUE_1, RED_1 -> 1;
212            case BLUE_2, RED_2 -> 2;
213            case BLUE_3, RED_3 -> 3;
214            case UNKNOWN -> 0;
215          };
216      final boolean isRedAlliance =
217          switch (allianceID) {
218            case BLUE_1, BLUE_2, BLUE_3 -> false;
219            case RED_1, RED_2, RED_3, UNKNOWN -> true;
220          };
221
222      String currentEventName;
223      String currentGameData;
224      int currentMatchNumber;
225      int currentReplayNumber;
226      int currentMatchType;
227      m_cacheDataMutex.lock();
228      try {
229        currentEventName = DriverStationBackend.m_matchInfo.eventName;
230        currentGameData = DriverStationBackend.m_gameData;
231        currentMatchNumber = DriverStationBackend.m_matchInfo.matchNumber;
232        currentReplayNumber = DriverStationBackend.m_matchInfo.replayNumber;
233        currentMatchType = DriverStationBackend.m_matchInfo.matchType;
234      } finally {
235        m_cacheDataMutex.unlock();
236      }
237      DriverStationJNI.getControlWord(currentControlWord);
238
239      if (oldIsRedAlliance != isRedAlliance) {
240        alliance.set(isRedAlliance);
241        oldIsRedAlliance = isRedAlliance;
242      }
243      if (oldStationNumber != stationNumber) {
244        station.set(stationNumber);
245        oldStationNumber = stationNumber;
246      }
247      if (oldAllianceStation != allianceID.ordinal()) {
248        allianceStation.set(allianceID.ordinal());
249        oldAllianceStation = allianceID.ordinal();
250      }
251      if (!oldEventName.equals(currentEventName)) {
252        eventName.set(currentEventName);
253        oldEventName = currentEventName;
254      }
255      if (!oldGameData.equals(currentGameData)) {
256        gameData.set(currentGameData);
257        oldGameData = currentGameData;
258      }
259      if (currentMatchNumber != oldMatchNumber) {
260        matchNumber.set(currentMatchNumber);
261        oldMatchNumber = currentMatchNumber;
262      }
263      if (currentReplayNumber != oldReplayNumber) {
264        replayNumber.set(currentReplayNumber);
265        oldReplayNumber = currentReplayNumber;
266      }
267      if (currentMatchType != oldMatchType) {
268        matchType.set(currentMatchType);
269        oldMatchType = currentMatchType;
270      }
271      if (!currentControlWord.equals(oldControlWord)) {
272        long currentOpModeId = currentControlWord.getOpModeId();
273        if (currentOpModeId != oldControlWord.getOpModeId()) {
274          opMode.set(opModeToString(currentOpModeId));
275        }
276        controlWord.set(currentControlWord);
277        oldControlWord.update(currentControlWord);
278      }
279    }
280  }

282  private static class JoystickLogSender {
283    JoystickLogSender(DataLog log, int stick, long timestamp) {
284      m_stick = stick;
285
286      m_logButtons = new BooleanArrayLogEntry(log, "DS:joystick" + stick + "/buttons", timestamp);
287      m_logAxes = new FloatArrayLogEntry(log, "DS:joystick" + stick + "/axes", timestamp);
288      m_logPOVs = new IntegerArrayLogEntry(log, "DS:joystick" + stick + "/povs", timestamp);
289
290      appendButtons(m_joystickButtons[m_stick], timestamp);
291      appendAxes(m_joystickAxes[m_stick], timestamp);
292      appendPOVs(m_joystickPOVs[m_stick], timestamp);
293    }
294
295    public void send(long timestamp) {
296      HALJoystickButtons buttons = m_joystickButtons[m_stick];
297      if (buttons.m_available != m_prevButtons.m_available
298          || buttons.m_buttons != m_prevButtons.m_buttons) {
299        appendButtons(buttons, timestamp);
300      }
301
302      HALJoystickAxes axes = m_joystickAxes[m_stick];
303      int available = axes.m_available;
304      boolean needToLog = false;
305      if (available != m_prevAxes.m_available) {
306        needToLog = true;
307      } else {
308        for (int i = 0; i < m_prevAxes.m_axes.length; i++) {
309          if (axes.m_axes[i] != m_prevAxes.m_axes[i]) {
310            needToLog = true;
311            break;
312          }
313        }
314      }
315      if (needToLog) {
316        appendAxes(axes, timestamp);
317      }
318
319      HALJoystickPOVs povs = m_joystickPOVs[m_stick];
320      available = m_joystickPOVs[m_stick].m_available;
321      needToLog = false;
322      if (available != m_prevPOVs.m_available) {
323        needToLog = true;
324      } else {
325        for (int i = 0; i < m_prevPOVs.m_povs.length; i++) {
326          if (povs.m_povs[i] != m_prevPOVs.m_povs[i]) {
327            needToLog = true;
328            break;
329          }
330        }
331      }
332      if (needToLog) {
333        appendPOVs(povs, timestamp);
334      }
335    }
336
337    void appendButtons(HALJoystickButtons buttons, long timestamp) {
338      int count = availableToCount(buttons.m_available);
339      if (m_sizedButtons == null || m_sizedButtons.length != count) {
340        m_sizedButtons = new boolean[count];
341      }
342      long buttonsValue = buttons.m_buttons;
343      for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) {
344        m_sizedButtons[i] = (buttonsValue & (1L << i)) != 0;
345      }
346      m_logButtons.append(m_sizedButtons, timestamp);
347      m_prevButtons.m_available = buttons.m_available;
348      m_prevButtons.m_buttons = buttons.m_buttons;
349    }
350
351    void appendAxes(HALJoystickAxes axes, long timestamp) {
352      int count = availableToCount(axes.m_available);
353      if (m_sizedAxes == null || m_sizedAxes.length != count) {
354        m_sizedAxes = new float[count];
355      }
356      System.arraycopy(axes.m_axes, 0, m_sizedAxes, 0, count);
357      m_logAxes.append(m_sizedAxes, timestamp);
358      m_prevAxes.m_available = axes.m_available;
359      System.arraycopy(axes.m_axes, 0, m_prevAxes.m_axes, 0, count);
360    }
361
362    void appendPOVs(HALJoystickPOVs povs, long timestamp) {
363      int count = availableToCount(povs.m_available);
364      if (m_sizedPOVs == null || m_sizedPOVs.length != count) {
365        m_sizedPOVs = new long[count];
366      }
367      for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) {
368        m_sizedPOVs[i] = povs.m_povs[i];
369      }
370      m_logPOVs.append(m_sizedPOVs, timestamp);
371      m_prevPOVs.m_available = povs.m_available;
372      System.arraycopy(povs.m_povs, 0, m_prevPOVs.m_povs, 0, count);
373    }
374
375    final int m_stick;
376    boolean[] m_sizedButtons;
377    float[] m_sizedAxes;
378    long[] m_sizedPOVs;
379    final HALJoystickButtons m_prevButtons = new HALJoystickButtons();
380    final HALJoystickAxes m_prevAxes = new HALJoystickAxes(DriverStationJNI.MAX_JOYSTICK_AXES);
381    final HALJoystickPOVs m_prevPOVs = new HALJoystickPOVs(DriverStationJNI.MAX_JOYSTICK_POVS);
382    final BooleanArrayLogEntry m_logButtons;
383    final FloatArrayLogEntry m_logAxes;
384    final IntegerArrayLogEntry m_logPOVs;
385  }

387  private static class DataLogSender {
388    DataLogSender(DataLog log, boolean logJoysticks, long timestamp) {
389      m_logControlWord =
390          StructLogEntry.create(log, "DS:controlWord", ControlWord.struct, timestamp);
391
392      // append initial control word value
393      m_logControlWord.append(m_controlWordCache, timestamp);
394      m_oldControlWord.update(m_controlWordCache);
395
396      // append initial opmode value
397      m_logOpMode = new StringLogEntry(log, "DS:opMode", timestamp);
398      m_logOpMode.append(m_opModeCache, timestamp);
399
400      if (logJoysticks) {
401        m_joysticks = new JoystickLogSender[JOYSTICK_PORTS];
402        for (int i = 0; i < JOYSTICK_PORTS; i++) {
403          m_joysticks[i] = new JoystickLogSender(log, i, timestamp);
404        }
405      } else {
406        m_joysticks = new JoystickLogSender[0];
407      }
408    }
409
410    public void send(long timestamp) {
411      // append control word value changes
412      if (!m_controlWordCache.equals(m_oldControlWord)) {
413        // append opmode value changes
414        long opModeId = m_controlWordCache.getOpModeId();
415        if (opModeId != m_oldControlWord.getOpModeId()) {
416          m_logOpMode.append(m_opModeCache, timestamp);
417        }
418
419        m_logControlWord.append(m_controlWordCache, timestamp);
420        m_oldControlWord.update(m_controlWordCache);
421      }
422
423      // append joystick value changes
424      for (JoystickLogSender joystick : m_joysticks) {
425        joystick.send(timestamp);
426      }
427    }
428
429    final ControlWord m_oldControlWord = new ControlWord();
430    final StructLogEntry<ControlWord> m_logControlWord;
431    final StringLogEntry m_logOpMode;
432
433    final JoystickLogSender[] m_joysticks;
434  }

473  private enum JoystickResourceAlert {
474    BUTTON("ButtonUnavailable", "Button"),
475    AXIS("AxisUnavailable", "axis"),
476    POV("POVUnavailable", "POV");
477
478    final String idSuffix;
479    final String label;
480
481    JoystickResourceAlert(String idSuffix, String label) {
482      this.idSuffix = idSuffix;
483      this.label = label;
484    }
485
486    boolean isAvailable(int stick, int resource) {
487      return switch (this) {
488        case BUTTON -> (getStickButtonsAvailable(stick) & (1L << resource)) != 0;
489        case AXIS -> (getStickAxesAvailable(stick) & (1 << resource)) != 0;
490        case POV -> (getStickPOVsAvailable(stick) & (1 << resource)) != 0;
491      };
492    }
493
494    String getText(int stick, int resource) {
495      return "Joystick " + label + " " + resource + " on port " + stick + " not available";
496    }
497  }
498
499  private static final JoystickResourceAlert[] JOYSTICK_RESOURCE_ALERTS =
500      JoystickResourceAlert.values();
501
502  private static final class JoystickAlertState {
503    Alert alert;
504    boolean active;
505  }
506
507  private static final class JoystickAlerts {
508    final int stick;
509    final String connectionText;
510    final JoystickAlertState connectionAlert = new JoystickAlertState();
511    final JoystickAlertState[] resourceAlerts =
512        new JoystickAlertState[JOYSTICK_RESOURCE_ALERTS.length];
513    final JoystickAlertState touchpadFingerAlert = new JoystickAlertState();
514    final int[] resourceAlertValues = new int[JOYSTICK_RESOURCE_ALERTS.length];
515    int touchpadFingerAlertTouchpad;
516    int touchpadFingerAlertFinger;
517    boolean initialized;
518
519    JoystickAlerts(int stick) {
520      this.stick = stick;
521      connectionText =
522          "Joystick on port " + stick + " not available, check if controller is plugged in";
523      for (int i = 0; i < resourceAlerts.length; i++) {
524        resourceAlerts[i] = new JoystickAlertState();
525      }
526      initializeAlerts();
527    }
528
529    boolean initializeAlerts() {
530      closeAlerts();
531
532      Alert newConnectionAlert = null;
533      Alert[] newResourceAlerts = new Alert[JOYSTICK_RESOURCE_ALERTS.length];
534      Alert newTouchpadFingerAlert = null;
535
536      try {
537        newConnectionAlert =
538            new Alert(
539                "DriverStation",
540                "joystick" + stick + "Disconnected",
541                connectionText,
542                Alert.Level.HIGH);
543        for (JoystickResourceAlert resourceAlert : JOYSTICK_RESOURCE_ALERTS) {
544          newResourceAlerts[resourceAlert.ordinal()] =
545              new Alert(
546                  "DriverStation",
547                  "joystick" + stick + resourceAlert.idSuffix,
548                  "",
549                  Alert.Level.MEDIUM);
550        }
551        newTouchpadFingerAlert =
552            new Alert(
553                "DriverStation",
554                "joystick" + stick + "TouchpadFingerUnavailable",
555                "",
556                Alert.Level.MEDIUM);
557      } catch (AlertException ex) {
558        closeAlert(newConnectionAlert);
559        for (Alert alert : newResourceAlerts) {
560          closeAlert(alert);
561        }
562        closeAlert(newTouchpadFingerAlert);
563        initialized = false;
564        return false;
565      }
566
567      connectionAlert.alert = newConnectionAlert;
568      for (JoystickResourceAlert resourceAlert : JOYSTICK_RESOURCE_ALERTS) {
569        resourceAlerts[resourceAlert.ordinal()].alert = newResourceAlerts[resourceAlert.ordinal()];
570      }
571      touchpadFingerAlert.alert = newTouchpadFingerAlert;
572      initialized = true;
573      return true;
574    }
575
576    void closeAlerts() {
577      closeAlert(connectionAlert);
578      for (JoystickAlertState alertState : resourceAlerts) {
579        closeAlert(alertState);
580      }
581      closeAlert(touchpadFingerAlert);
582      initialized = false;
583    }
584
585    static void closeAlert(JoystickAlertState alertState) {
586      closeAlert(alertState.alert);
587      alertState.alert = null;
588      alertState.active = false;
589    }
590
591    static void closeAlert(Alert alert) {
592      if (alert == null) {
593        return;
594      }
595
596      try {
597        alert.close();
598      } catch (AlertException ex) {
599        // Ignore stale handles while cleaning up a failed initialization attempt.
600      }
601    }
602
603    boolean prepareForReport() {
604      if (isJoystickConnected(stick)) {
605        setAlert(connectionAlert, false, connectionText, true);
606        return true;
607      }
608
609      clearResourceAlerts();
610      setAlert(connectionAlert, true, connectionText, true);
611      return false;
612    }
613
614    void refresh() {
615      if (!isJoystickConnected(stick)) {
616        clearResourceAlerts();
617        return;
618      }
619
620      if (connectionAlert.active) {
621        setAlert(connectionAlert, false, connectionText, true);
622      }
623
624      for (JoystickResourceAlert resourceAlert : JOYSTICK_RESOURCE_ALERTS) {
625        refreshResourceAlert(resourceAlert);
626      }
627
628      if (touchpadFingerAlert.active
629          && getStickTouchpadFingerAvailable(
630              stick, touchpadFingerAlertTouchpad, touchpadFingerAlertFinger)) {
631        setAlert(touchpadFingerAlert, false);
632      }
633    }
634
635    void clearAllAlerts() {
636      setAlert(connectionAlert, false, connectionText, true);
637      clearResourceAlerts();
638    }
639
640    void clearResourceAlerts() {
641      for (JoystickAlertState alertState : resourceAlerts) {
642        setAlert(alertState, false);
643      }
644      setAlert(touchpadFingerAlert, false);
645    }
646
647    void refreshResourceAlert(JoystickResourceAlert resourceAlert) {
648      int alertIndex = resourceAlert.ordinal();
649      JoystickAlertState alertState = resourceAlerts[alertIndex];
650      if (alertState.active && resourceAlert.isAvailable(stick, resourceAlertValues[alertIndex])) {
651        setAlert(alertState, false);
652      }
653    }
654
655    void reportResourceWarning(JoystickResourceAlert resourceAlert, int resource) {
656      int alertIndex = resourceAlert.ordinal();
657      resourceAlertValues[alertIndex] = resource;
658      setAlert(resourceAlerts[alertIndex], true, resourceAlert.getText(stick, resource), false);
659    }
660
661    void reportTouchpadFingerWarning(int touchpad, int finger) {
662      String text =
663          "Joystick touchpad finger "
664              + finger
665              + " on touchpad "
666              + touchpad
667              + " on port "
668              + stick
669              + " not available";
670      touchpadFingerAlertTouchpad = touchpad;
671      touchpadFingerAlertFinger = finger;
672      setAlert(touchpadFingerAlert, true, text, false);
673    }
674
675    boolean applyAlert(
676        JoystickAlertState alertState, boolean active, String text, boolean verifyActive) {
677      if (alertState.alert == null) {
678        return false;
679      }
680
681      try {
682        if (active && !text.isEmpty()) {
683          alertState.alert.setText(text);
684        }
685        alertState.alert.set(active);
686        return !active || !verifyActive || alertState.alert.get();
687      } catch (AlertException ex) {
688        return false;
689      }
690    }
691
692    boolean setAlert(JoystickAlertState alertState, boolean active) {
693      return setAlert(alertState, active, "", false);
694    }
695
696    boolean setAlert(
697        JoystickAlertState alertState, boolean active, String text, boolean verifyActive) {
698      if (!active && !alertState.active) {
699        return true;
700      }
701
702      if (active && !initialized && !initializeAlerts()) {
703        return false;
704      }
705
706      if (!applyAlert(alertState, active, text, verifyActive)) {
707        if (!active) {
708          alertState.active = false;
709          return true;
710        }
711        if (!initializeAlerts()) {
712          return false;
713        }
714        if (!applyAlert(alertState, active, text, verifyActive)) {
715          return false;
716        }
717      }
718      alertState.active = active;
719      return true;
720    }
721  }

799  private static void reportErrorImpl(boolean isError, int code, String error, boolean printTrace) {
800    reportErrorImpl(isError, code, error, printTrace, Thread.currentThread().getStackTrace(), 3);
801  }
802
803  private static void reportErrorImpl(
804      boolean isError, int code, String error, StackTraceElement[] stackTrace) {
805    reportErrorImpl(isError, code, error, true, stackTrace, 0);
806  }
807
808  private static void reportErrorImpl(
809      boolean isError,
810      int code,
811      String error,
812      boolean printTrace,
813      StackTraceElement[] stackTrace,
814      int stackTraceFirst) {
815    String locString;
816    if (stackTrace.length >= stackTraceFirst + 1) {
817      locString = stackTrace[stackTraceFirst].toString();
818    } else {
819      locString = "";
820    }
821    StringBuilder traceString = new StringBuilder();
822    if (printTrace) {
823      boolean haveLoc = false;
824      for (int i = stackTraceFirst; i < stackTrace.length; i++) {
825        String loc = stackTrace[i].toString();
826        traceString.append("\tat ").append(loc).append('\n');
827        // get first user function
828        if (!haveLoc && !loc.startsWith("org.wpilib")) {
829          locString = loc;
830          haveLoc = true;
831        }
832      }
833    }
834    DriverStationJNI.sendError(isError, code, error, locString, traceString.toString(), true);
835  }
836
837  /**
838   * Report crash to Driver Station. Appends provided stack trace to crash message.
839   *
840   * @param error The error message
841   * @param stackTrace The stack trace to append
842   */
843  public static void reportCrash(String error, StackTraceElement[] stackTrace) {
844    reportCrashImpl(error, stackTrace, 0);
845  }
846
847  private static void reportCrashImpl(
848      String error, StackTraceElement[] stackTrace, int stackTraceFirst) {
849    String locString;
850    if (stackTrace.length >= stackTraceFirst + 1) {
851      locString = stackTrace[stackTraceFirst].toString();
852    } else {
853      locString = "";
854    }
855    StringBuilder traceString = new StringBuilder();
856    boolean haveLoc = false;
857    for (int i = stackTraceFirst; i < stackTrace.length; i++) {
858      String loc = stackTrace[i].toString();
859      traceString.append("\tat ").append(loc).append('\n');
860      // get first user function
861      if (!haveLoc && !loc.startsWith("org.wpilib")) {
862        locString = loc;
863        haveLoc = true;
864      }
865    }
866    DriverStationJNI.sendProgramCrash(error, locString, traceString.toString());
867    // Sleep to ensure message is sent before crash
868    try {
869      Thread.sleep(100);
870    } catch (InterruptedException e) {
871      Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
872    }
873  }

875  /**
876   * The state of one joystick button.
877   *
878   * @param stick The joystick to read.
879   * @param button The button index.
880   * @return The state of the joystick button.
881   */
882  public static boolean getStickButton(final int stick, final int button) {
883    if (stick < 0 || stick >= JOYSTICK_PORTS) {
884      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Joystick index is out of range, should be 0-5");
885    }
886    if (button < 0 || button >= DriverStationJNI.MAX_JOYSTICK_BUTTONS) {
887      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Joystick Button is out of range");
888    }
889
890    long mask = 1L << button;
891
892    m_cacheDataMutex.lock();
893    try {
894      if ((m_joystickButtons[stick].m_available & mask) != 0) {
895        return (m_joystickButtons[stick].m_buttons & mask) != 0;
896      }
897    } finally {
898      m_cacheDataMutex.unlock();
899    }
900
901    reportJoystickResourceWarning(stick, JoystickResourceAlert.BUTTON, button);
902    return false;
903  }

905  /**
906   * The state of one joystick button if available.
907   *
908   * @param stick The joystick to read.
909   * @param button The button index.
910   * @return The state of the joystick button, or false if the button is not available.
911   */
912  public static Optional<Boolean> getStickButtonIfAvailable(final int stick, final int button) {
913    if (stick < 0 || stick >= JOYSTICK_PORTS) {
914      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Joystick index is out of range, should be 0-5");
915    }
916    if (button < 0 || button >= DriverStationJNI.MAX_JOYSTICK_BUTTONS) {
917      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Joystick Button is out of range");
918    }
919
920    long mask = 1L << button;
921
922    m_cacheDataMutex.lock();
923    try {
924      if ((m_joystickButtons[stick].m_available & mask) != 0) {
925        return Optional.of((m_joystickButtons[stick].m_buttons & mask) != 0);
926      }
927    } finally {
928      m_cacheDataMutex.unlock();
929    }
930    return Optional.empty();
931  }

933  /**
934   * Whether one joystick button was pressed since the last check.
935   *
936   * @param stick The joystick to read.
937   * @param button The button index.
938   * @return Whether the joystick button was pressed since the last check.
939   */
940  public static boolean getStickButtonPressed(final int stick, final int button) {
941    if (stick < 0 || stick >= JOYSTICK_PORTS) {
942      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Joystick index is out of range, should be 0-5");
943    }
944    if (button < 0 || button >= DriverStationJNI.MAX_JOYSTICK_BUTTONS) {
945      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Joystick Button is out of range");
946    }
947
948    long mask = 1L << button;
949
950    m_cacheDataMutex.lock();
951    try {
952      if ((m_joystickButtons[stick].m_available & mask) != 0) {
953        // If button was pressed, clear flag and return true
954        if ((m_joystickButtonsPressed[stick] & mask) != 0) {
955          m_joystickButtonsPressed[stick] &= ~mask;
956          return true;
957        } else {
958          return false;
959        }
960      }
961    } finally {
962      m_cacheDataMutex.unlock();
963    }
964
965    reportJoystickResourceWarning(stick, JoystickResourceAlert.BUTTON, button);
966    return false;
967  }

1021    int mask = 1 << axis;

1036  /**
1037   * Get the state of a touchpad finger on the joystick.
1038   *
1039   * @param stick The joystick to read.
1040   * @param touchpad The touchpad to read.
1041   * @param finger The finger to read.
1042   * @return the state of the touchpad finger.
1043   */
1044  public static TouchpadFinger getStickTouchpadFinger(int stick, int touchpad, int finger) {
1045    if (stick < 0 || stick >= JOYSTICK_PORTS) {
1046      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Joystick index is out of range, should be 0-5");
1047    }
1048    if (touchpad < 0 || touchpad >= DriverStationJNI.MAX_JOYSTICK_TOUCHPADS) {
1049      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Joystick touchpad is out of range");
1050    }
1051    if (finger < 0 || finger >= DriverStationJNI.MAX_JOYSTICK_TOUCHPAD_FINGERS) {
1052      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Joystick touchpad finger is out of range");
1053    }
1054
1055    int touchpadCount;
1056    m_cacheDataMutex.lock();
1057    try {
1058      touchpadCount = m_joystickTouchpads[stick].m_count;
1059      if (touchpad < touchpadCount) {
1060        HALJoystickTouchpad tp = m_joystickTouchpads[stick].m_touchpads[touchpad];
1061        if (finger < tp.m_count) {
1062          return new TouchpadFinger(
1063              tp.m_fingers[finger].m_down, tp.m_fingers[finger].m_x, tp.m_fingers[finger].m_y);
1064        }
1065      }
1066    } finally {
1067      m_cacheDataMutex.unlock();
1068    }
1069
1070    reportJoystickTouchpadFingerWarning(stick, touchpad, finger);
1071    return new TouchpadFinger(false, 0.0f, 0.0f);
1072  }

1485  private static int convertColorToInt(Color color) {
1486    if (color == null) {
1487      return -1;
1488    }
1489    return (((int) (color.red * 255) & 0xff) << 16)
1490        | (((int) (color.green * 255) & 0xff) << 8)
1491        | ((int) (color.blue * 255) & 0xff);
1492  }

1494  /**
1495   * Adds an operating mode option. It's necessary to call publishOpModes() to make the added modes
1496   * visible to the driver station.
1497   *
1498   * @param mode robot mode
1499   * @param name name of the operating mode
1500   * @param group group of the operating mode
1501   * @param description description of the operating mode
1502   * @param textColor text color, or null for default
1503   * @param backgroundColor background color, or null for default
1504   * @return unique ID used to later identify the operating mode
1505   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if name is empty or an operating mode with the same robot mode
1506   *     and name already exists
1507   */
1508  @SuppressWarnings("PMD.UseStringBufferForStringAppends")
1509  public static long addOpMode(
1510      RobotMode mode,
1511      String name,
1512      String group,
1513      String description,
1514      Color textColor,
1515      Color backgroundColor) {
1516    if (name.isBlank()) {
1517      throw new IllegalArgumentException("OpMode name must be non-blank");
1518    }
1519    // find unique ID
1520    m_opModesMutex.lock();
1521    try {
1522      String nameCopy = name;
1523      for (; ; ) {
1524        long id = OpModeOption.makeId(mode, nameCopy.hashCode());
1525        OpModeOption existing = m_opModes.get(id);
1526        if (existing == null) {
1527          m_opModes.put(
1528              id,
1529              new OpModeOption(
1530                  id,
1531                  name,
1532                  group,
1533                  description,
1534                  convertColorToInt(textColor),
1535                  convertColorToInt(backgroundColor)));
1536          return id;
1537        }
1538        if (existing.getMode() == mode && existing.name.equals(name)) {
1539          // already exists
1540          throw new IllegalArgumentException("OpMode " + name + " already exists for mode " + mode);
1541        }
1542        // collision, try again with space appended
1543        nameCopy += ' ';
1544      }
1545    } finally {
1546      m_opModesMutex.unlock();
1547    }
1548  }
1549

1595  /**
1596   * Removes an operating mode option. It's necessary to call publishOpModes() to make the removed
1597   * mode no longer visible to the driver station.
1598   *
1599   * @param mode robot mode
1600   * @param name name of the operating mode
1601   * @return unique ID for the opmode, or 0 if not found
1602   */
1603  public static long removeOpMode(RobotMode mode, String name) {
1604    if (name.isBlank()) {
1605      return 0;
1606    }
1607    m_opModesMutex.lock();
1608    try {
1609      // we have to loop over all entries to find the one with the correct name
1610      // because the of the unique ID generation scheme
1611      for (OpModeOption opMode : m_opModes.values()) {
1612        if (opMode.getMode() == mode && opMode.name.equals(name)) {
1613          m_opModes.remove(opMode.id);
1614          return opMode.id;
1615        }
1616      }
1617    } finally {
1618      m_opModesMutex.unlock();
1619    }
1620    return 0;
1621  }
1622
1623  /** Publishes the operating mode options to the driver station. */
1624  public static void publishOpModes() {
1625    m_opModesMutex.lock();
1626    try {
1627      OpModeOption[] options = new OpModeOption[m_opModes.size()];
1628      DriverStationJNI.setOpModeOptions(m_opModes.values().toArray(options));
1629    } finally {
1630      m_opModesMutex.unlock();
1631    }
1632
1633    var modeCounts =
1634        m_opModes.values().stream()
1635            .collect(Collectors.groupingBy(OpModeOption::getMode, Collectors.counting()));
1636
1637    for (RobotMode mode : RobotMode.values()) {
1638      UsageReporting.reportUsage(
1639          "OpMode/" + mode, String.valueOf(modeCounts.getOrDefault(mode, 0L)));
1640    }
1641  }
1642
1643  /** Clears all operating mode options and publishes an empty list to the driver station. */
1644  public static void clearOpModes() {

1648      DriverStationJNI.setOpModeOptions(new OpModeOption[0]);
1649    } finally {
1650      m_opModesMutex.unlock();
1651    }
1652  }

1654  /**
1655   * Sets the program starting flag in the DS. This will also allow {@link #getOpModeId()} and
1656   * {@link #getOpMode()} to return values for the selected OpMode in the DS application, if the DS
1657   * is connected by the time this method is called.
1658   *
1659   * <p>Most users will not need to use this method; the {@link TimedRobot} and {@link OpModeRobot}
1660   * robot framework classes will call it automatically after the main robot class is instantiated.
1661   * However, teams using the commandsv3 library and a custom main robot class need to be careful to
1662   * only call this method after all mechanisms and global trigger bindings are set up. If not, any
1663   * setup performed in the main robot class may be incorrectly bound to the opmode selected in the
1664   * DS if it's connected by the time the robot program boots up.
1665   *
1666   * <p>This is what changes the DS to showing robot code ready.
1667   *
1668   * @see #getOpMode()
1669   * @see #getOpModeId()
1670   */
1671  public static void observeUserProgramStarting() {
1672    m_userProgramStarted = true;
1673    DriverStationJNI.observeUserProgramStarting();
1674  }

1676  /**
1677   * Gets the operating mode selected on the driver station. Note this does not mean the robot is
1678   * enabled; use isEnabled() for that. In a match, this will indicate the operating mode selected
1679   * for auto before the match starts (i.e., while the robot is disabled in auto mode); after the
1680   * auto period ends, this will change to reflect the operating mode selected for teleop.
1681   *
1682   * <p>This method always returns {@code 0} while the main robot class is being constructed and
1683   * initialized (more specifically, it returns {@code 0} until {@link
1684   * #observeUserProgramStarting()} is called, which the WPILib framework will automatically call
1685   * during {@link TimedRobot#startCompetition()} and {@link OpModeRobot#startCompetition()}).
1686   *
1687   * @return the unique ID provided by the addOpMode() function; may return 0 or a unique ID not
1688   *     added, so callers should be prepared to handle that case
1689   */
1690  public static long getOpModeId() {
1691    if (!m_userProgramStarted) {
1692      return 0;
1693    }
1694
1695    m_cacheDataMutex.lock();
1696    try {
1697      return m_controlWord.getOpModeId();
1698    } finally {
1699      m_cacheDataMutex.unlock();
1700    }
1701  }

1926  /**
1927   * Return the approximate match time. The FMS does not send an official match time to the robots,
1928   * but does send an approximate match time. The value will count down the time remaining in the
1929   * current period (auto or teleop). Warning: This is not an official time (so it cannot be used to
1930   * dispute ref calls or guarantee that a function will trigger before the match ends).
1931   *
1932   * <p>When connected to the real field, this number only changes in full integer increments, and
1933   * always counts down.
1934   *
1935   * <p>When the DS is in practice mode, this number is a floating point number, and counts down.
1936   *
1937   * <p>When the DS is in teleop or autonomous mode, this number returns -1.0.
1938   *
1939   * <p>Simulation matches DS behavior without an FMS connected.
1940   *
1941   * @return Time remaining in current match period (auto or teleop) in seconds
1942   */
1943  public static double getMatchTime() {
1944    return DriverStationJNI.getMatchTime();

1947  /**
1948   * Allows the user to specify whether they want joystick connection alerts to be shown. This
1949   * setting is ignored when the FMS is connected -- alerts will always be on in that scenario.
1950   *
1951   * @param silence Whether joystick connection alerts should be silenced.
1952   */
1953  public static void silenceJoystickConnectionAlert(boolean silence) {
1954    m_joystickAlertMutex.lock();
1955    try {
1956      m_silenceJoystickAlerts = silence;
1957      if (silence && !isFMSAttached()) {
1958        clearJoystickAlertsLocked();
1959      }
1960    } finally {
1961      m_joystickAlertMutex.unlock();
1962    }
1963  }

1972    m_joystickAlertMutex.lock();

1974      return !isFMSAttached() && m_silenceJoystickAlerts;
1975    } finally {

1977    }

1994  /**
1995   * Copy data from the DS task for the user. If no new data exists, it will just be returned,
1996   * otherwise the data will be copied from the DS polling loop.
1997   */
1998  public static void refreshData() {
1999    DriverStationJNI.refreshDSData();
2000
2001    // Get the status of all the joysticks
2002    for (byte stick = 0; stick < JOYSTICK_PORTS; stick++) {
2003      DriverStationJNI.getAllJoystickData(
2004          stick,
2005          m_joystickAxesCache[stick].m_axes,
2006          m_joystickAxesRawCache[stick].m_axes,
2007          m_joystickPOVsCache[stick].m_povs,
2008          m_touchpadFingersCache,
2009          m_metadataCache);
2010      m_joystickAxesCache[stick].m_available = (int) m_metadataCache[0];
2011      m_joystickAxesRawCache[stick].m_available = (int) m_metadataCache[0];
2012      m_joystickPOVsCache[stick].m_available = (int) m_metadataCache[1];
2013      m_joystickButtonsCache[stick].m_available = m_metadataCache[2];
2014      m_joystickButtonsCache[stick].m_buttons = m_metadataCache[3];
2015      m_joystickTouchpadsCache[stick].m_count = (int) m_metadataCache[4];
2016      for (int i = 0; i < m_joystickTouchpadsCache[stick].m_count; i++) {
2017        long metadata = m_metadataCache[5 + i];
2018        m_joystickTouchpadsCache[stick].m_touchpads[i].m_fingers[0].m_down = (metadata & 0x1) != 0;
2019        m_joystickTouchpadsCache[stick].m_touchpads[i].m_fingers[1].m_down = (metadata & 0x2) != 0;
2020        m_joystickTouchpadsCache[stick].m_touchpads[i].m_count = (int) (metadata >> 2 & 0x3);
2021        for (int j = 0; j < m_joystickTouchpadsCache[stick].m_touchpads[i].m_count; j++) {
2022          m_joystickTouchpadsCache[stick].m_touchpads[i].m_fingers[j].m_x =
2023              m_touchpadFingersCache[i * 4 + j * 2 + 0];
2024          m_joystickTouchpadsCache[stick].m_touchpads[i].m_fingers[j].m_y =
2025              m_touchpadFingersCache[i * 4 + j * 2 + 1];
2026        }
2027      }
2028    }
2029
2030    DriverStationJNI.getMatchInfo(m_matchInfoCache);
2031
2032    // This is a pass through, so if it hasn't changed, it doesn't
2033    // reallocate
2034    m_gameDataCache = DriverStationJNI.getGameData(m_gameDataCache);
2035
2036    DriverStationJNI.getControlWord(m_controlWordCache);
2037
2038    m_opModeCache = opModeToString(m_controlWordCache.getOpModeId());
2039
2040    DataLogSender dataLogSender;
2041    // lock joystick mutex to swap cache data
2042    m_cacheDataMutex.lock();
2043    try {
2044      for (int i = 0; i < JOYSTICK_PORTS; i++) {
2045        // If buttons weren't pressed and are now, set flags in m_buttonsPressed
2046        m_joystickButtonsPressed[i] |=
2047            ~m_joystickButtons[i].m_buttons & m_joystickButtonsCache[i].m_buttons;
2048
2049        // If buttons were pressed and aren't now, set flags in m_buttonsReleased
2050        m_joystickButtonsReleased[i] |=
2051            m_joystickButtons[i].m_buttons & ~m_joystickButtonsCache[i].m_buttons;
2052      }
2053
2054      // move cache to actual data
2055      HALJoystickAxes[] currentAxes = m_joystickAxes;
2056      m_joystickAxes = m_joystickAxesCache;
2057      m_joystickAxesCache = currentAxes;
2058
2059      HALJoystickAxesRaw[] currentAxesRaw = m_joystickAxesRaw;
2060      m_joystickAxesRaw = m_joystickAxesRawCache;
2061      m_joystickAxesRawCache = currentAxesRaw;
2062
2063      HALJoystickButtons[] currentButtons = m_joystickButtons;
2064      m_joystickButtons = m_joystickButtonsCache;
2065      m_joystickButtonsCache = currentButtons;
2066
2067      HALJoystickPOVs[] currentPOVs = m_joystickPOVs;
2068      m_joystickPOVs = m_joystickPOVsCache;
2069      m_joystickPOVsCache = currentPOVs;
2070
2071      HALJoystickTouchpads[] currentTouchpads = m_joystickTouchpads;
2072      m_joystickTouchpads = m_joystickTouchpadsCache;
2073      m_joystickTouchpadsCache = currentTouchpads;
2074
2075      MatchInfoData currentInfo = m_matchInfo;
2076      m_matchInfo = m_matchInfoCache;
2077      m_matchInfoCache = currentInfo;
2078
2079      m_gameData = m_gameDataCache;
2080
2081      ControlWord currentWord = m_controlWord;
2082      m_controlWord = m_controlWordCache;
2083      m_controlWordCache = currentWord;
2084
2085      String currentOpMode = m_opMode;
2086      m_opMode = m_opModeCache;
2087      m_opModeCache = currentOpMode;
2088
2089      dataLogSender = m_dataLogSender;
2090    } finally {
2091      m_cacheDataMutex.unlock();
2092    }
2093
2094    clearJoystickAlerts();
2095
2096    m_refreshEvents.wakeup();
2097
2098    m_matchDataSender.sendMatchData();
2099    if (dataLogSender != null) {
2100      dataLogSender.send(WPIUtilJNI.now());
2101    }
2102  }

2104  /**
2105   * Registers the given handle for DS data refresh notifications.
2106   *
2107   * @param handle The event handle.
2108   */
2109  public static void provideRefreshedDataEventHandle(int handle) {
2110    m_refreshEvents.add(handle);
2111  }
2112
2113  /**
2114   * Unregisters the given handle from DS data refresh notifications.
2115   *
2116   * @param handle The event handle.
2117   */
2118  public static void removeRefreshedDataEventHandle(int handle) {
2119    m_refreshEvents.remove(handle);
2120  }

2122  private static JoystickAlerts getJoystickAlertsLocked(int stick) {
2123    JoystickAlerts alerts = m_joystickAlerts[stick];
2124    if (alerts == null) {
2125      alerts = new JoystickAlerts(stick);
2126      m_joystickAlerts[stick] = alerts;
2127    }
2128    return alerts;
2129  }
2130
2131  private static void reportJoystickResourceWarning(
2132      int stick, JoystickResourceAlert resourceAlert, int resource) {
2133    m_joystickAlertMutex.lock();
2134    try {
2135      if (!isFMSAttached() && m_silenceJoystickAlerts) {
2136        return;
2137      }
2138
2139      JoystickAlerts alerts = getJoystickAlertsLocked(stick);
2140      if (!alerts.prepareForReport()) {
2141        return;
2142      }
2143
2144      alerts.reportResourceWarning(resourceAlert, resource);
2145    } finally {
2146      m_joystickAlertMutex.unlock();
2147    }
2148  }
2149
2150  private static void reportJoystickTouchpadFingerWarning(int stick, int touchpad, int finger) {
2151    m_joystickAlertMutex.lock();
2152    try {
2153      if (!isFMSAttached() && m_silenceJoystickAlerts) {
2154        return;
2155      }
2156
2157      JoystickAlerts alerts = getJoystickAlertsLocked(stick);
2158      if (!alerts.prepareForReport()) {
2159        return;
2160      }
2161
2162      alerts.reportTouchpadFingerWarning(touchpad, finger);
2163    } finally {
2164      m_joystickAlertMutex.unlock();
2165    }
2166  }
2167
2168  private static void clearJoystickAlerts() {
2169    m_joystickAlertMutex.lock();
2170    try {
2171      clearJoystickAlertsLocked();
2172    } finally {
2173      m_joystickAlertMutex.unlock();
2174    }
2175  }
2176
2177  private static void clearJoystickAlertsLocked() {
2178    if (!isFMSAttached() && m_silenceJoystickAlerts) {
2179      for (JoystickAlerts alerts : m_joystickAlerts) {
2180        if (alerts != null) {
2181          alerts.clearAllAlerts();
2182        }
2183      }
2184      return;
2185    }
2186
2187    for (JoystickAlerts alerts : m_joystickAlerts) {
2188      if (alerts != null) {
2189        alerts.refresh();
2190      }
2191    }
2192  }

2194  /**
2195   * Starts logging DriverStation data to data log. Repeated calls are ignored.
2196   *
2197   * @param log data log
2198   * @param logJoysticks if true, log joystick data
2199   */
2200  @SuppressWarnings("PMD.NonThreadSafeSingleton")
2201  public static void startDataLog(DataLog log, boolean logJoysticks) {
2202    m_cacheDataMutex.lock();
2203    try {
2204      if (m_dataLogSender == null) {
2205        m_dataLogSender = new DataLogSender(log, logJoysticks, WPIUtilJNI.now());
2206      }
2207    } finally {
2208      m_cacheDataMutex.unlock();
2209    }
2210  }

2212  /**
2213   * Starts logging DriverStation data to data log, including joystick data. Repeated calls are
2214   * ignored.
2215   *
2216   * @param log data log
2217   */
2218  public static void startDataLog(DataLog log) {
2219    startDataLog(log, true);
2220  }
